qa.title: Q736 (Jun. 14, 2024)
qa.question: If I select an evolved enemy Galmieux, Omen of Disdain with 3 or less defense when playing this spell with Quick during my opponent's turn, does Galmieux's "Whenever this follower takes ability damage" ability trigger twice?
qa.answer: Yes. This spell first deals 3 damage to Galmieux, bringing her to 0 or less defense. However, she isn't destroyed until the next Confirmation Timing, which occurs after this spell is resolved. This spell then deals 2 more damage to Galmieux, even though her defense is already 0 or less. Therefore, Galmieux takes ability damage twice, and her ability is triggered twice. Note that the same would apply to Servant of Disdain.

qa.title: Q699 (Jun. 14, 2024)
qa.question: How do I discard a random card?
qa.answer: For example, if you have 6 cards, you could assign each card a number from 1 to 6 and then roll a 6-sided die. If you have 3, you could assign two numbers to each card and then roll. If you have two, you could assign three numbers or flip a coin. Alternatively, you could shuffle your hand and simply have someone else pick a card.

qa.title: Q723 (Jun. 14, 2024)
qa.question: Does this amulet's ability mean my leader can't take more than a total of 4 damage on the turn I activate it?
qa.answer:
No. Any single instance of damage greater than 4 dealt to your leader that turn is reduced to 4.

For example, if your leader takes 5 damage twice, both instances are reduced to 4 for a total of 8 damage. If your leader takes 6 damage and then 3 damage, the first instance is reduced to 4 and the second is unaffected, giving a total of 7 damage.
